name: osint-toolbox-mcp
description: Run Sherlock, Maigret, Holehe, GHunt, theHarvester, SpiderFoot, Blackbird, PhoneInfoga and ExifTool locally.
long_description:
Lets the assistant run classic OSINT tools on your machine: username searches (Sherlock, Maigret, Blackbird), email checks (Holehe, GHunt), domain reconnaissance (theHarvester, SpiderFoot), phone number scans (PhoneInfoga) and file metadata (ExifTool). No API keys are needed.

The tools themselves are installed separately; only the ones found on your machine are offered. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/renkagod/osint-toolbox-mcp#install-the-tools).

tools.name: sherlock_username_search
tools.description: Find accounts that use a username on 400+ sites (Sherlock)

tools.name: holehe_email_search
tools.description: Check which of about 120 sites have an account for an email address (Holehe)

tools.name: spiderfoot_scan
tools.description: Run a SpiderFoot scan of a domain, IP, email, phone number, username or name

tools.name: ghunt_google_search
tools.description: Look up a Google account by email address or Gaia ID (GHunt)

tools.name: maigret_username_search
tools.description: Search a username on up to 3000+ sites and extract profile data (Maigret)

tools.name: theharvester_domain_search
tools.description: Collect emails, subdomains, hosts and IPs for a domain (theHarvester)

tools.name: blackbird_username_search
tools.description: Search a username on the 700+ sites of the WhatsMyName list (Blackbird)

tools.name: phoneinfoga_scan
tools.description: Scan a phone number: country, carrier, formats and search queries (PhoneInfoga)

tools.name: exiftool_metadata
tools.description: Read metadata of a local photo, video or document (ExifTool)

spiderfoot_dir.title: SpiderFoot folder
spiderfoot_dir.description: Your SpiderFoot checkout (the folder with sf.py). Leave empty if you don't use SpiderFoot.

blackbird_dir.title: Blackbird folder
blackbird_dir.description: Your Blackbird checkout (the folder with blackbird.py). Leave empty if you don't use Blackbird.

exiftool_path.title: ExifTool program
exiftool_path.description: Only needed when exiftool is not on PATH.
